lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with a prominent triad of macro-blobs in the mid-flank quadrant.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with primary circular blobs to define a rectilinear grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge originating above the branchial region, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light dorsal edge and shadowed ventral trough.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular white cluster of high-intensity pixels located at the dorsal apex of the first visible gill slit, indicative of a localized lesion or parasitic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition from high-density, low-diameter pixel clusters on the rostrum and cephalic region to lower-density, high-diameter macro-blobs posterior to the ocular region.
